main.description: A person's own 0-10 rating of one site the buildthis bot has built, RateYourMusic-style, with an optional written review. One record per site — the record key is the site's bare name (e.g. "steamtags"), so re-rating (or re-reviewing) a site overwrites its record in place rather than creating a new one. Written and read by rateyourbuild (https://rateyourbuild.bisks.net).

subject.description: The bare name of the rated site (sites/<name>/, served at <name>.bisks.net) — not its URL. The record's rkey is this value.

score.description: The rater's own judgement of the site, 0 (worst) to 10 (best).

ratedAt.description: When this record was last written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.

text.description: An optional written review to go with the score, RateYourMusic-style. Omit for a bare rating.
